dialogues.speaker: Akram
dialogues.text: You must know yourself as well as your enemy to win every battle, wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Akram
dialogues.text: As you've seen, I'm a member of the Corps of Thirty. Naturally, we're responsible for keeping the peace in Sumeru City.

dialogues.speaker: Akram
dialogues.text: Theft, meanwhile, is the most common crime we see in the more crowded parts of the city.

dialogues.speaker: Akram
dialogues.text: How else can you catch a thief except by being familiar with how a thief thieves?

dialogues.speaker: Akram
dialogues.text: When my younger brother sees me occasionally — VERY occasionally, mind you! — simulate a theft in action, he always exposes my technique.

dialogues.speaker: Akram
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to improve that way!?
